_note: Stage 8 voice catalogue. Each speaking persona: a fallback prebuilt voice, the voice design prompt (permanent traits drawn from the public persona: apparent age, work, region, temperament) and a short delivery style drawn from the case family's speaking style (verbosity, register, fluency, language), never from the subject's role and never from affect, so nothing in a voice is a stress cue (PRB-4). voice_id is the stored project voice scripts/design_voices.py created from the prompt (null until designed). Synthetic characters only: no voice is replicated from a real person.

subject:Jordan Pell.description: A man in his late thirties who has fixed building systems for years: a warm, slightly husky baritone with a neutral American accent, practical and plainspoken.
subject:Jordan Pell.style: plainspoken and casual, keeps answers short

subject:Mara Quell.description: A records clerk in her mid forties: a measured, clear alto with a neutral American accent, precise and orderly.
subject:Mara Quell.style: formal and unhurried, explains at length and now and then searches for a word

subject:Avery Lindqvist.description: An IT support specialist in his late twenties who learned English as an adult, with a light Scandinavian accent: a bright, clear tenor, careful and articulate.
subject:Avery Lindqvist.style: formal and careful, explains at length in clear second-language English

subject:Dana Okafor.description: A mailroom clerk in her early fifties: a clear, warm mezzo with a neutral American accent, steady and polite.
subject:Dana Okafor.style: formal and brief, now and then searches for a word

subject:Rafael Strand.description: A data center operator in his early forties: a low, even baritone with a neutral American accent, relaxed and easygoing.
subject:Rafael Strand.style: casual and unhurried, explains at length

subject:Priya Halloran.description: A building engineer in her mid thirties: a clear, direct mid-range voice with a neutral American accent, practical and exact.

subject:Glen Mattick.description: A supply technician in his late fifties: a slightly gravelly, friendly baritone with a neutral American accent, chatty and down to earth.
subject:Glen Mattick.style: casual and talkative, now and then searches for a word

subject:Elise Dunmore.description: A procurement assistant in her late twenties: a bright, composed voice with a neutral American accent, organised and polite.
